selection: Pre-existing K=1 physical canary, before inspecting its long response; no search.
contrast: Homogeneous noisy zero-core background versus localized one-core noisy bursting regime; not a one-factor core ablation
D: Zero-core network; uniform background threshold and weights; independent Poisson arrivals to every cell at background nu; no local OU/input patch
E: Unchanged original one-core E; retained as separate reference trajectory
statistical_unit: One 10 s trajectory on one topology; no independent seed repetition
operational_burst: Non-overlapping 10 ms bins: >=1% distinct E cells globally or >=10% distinct E cells in fixed input patch; adjacent supra-threshold bins merged across <=100 ms gaps; report duration, do not equate with patient HFO.
sparse_definition: Descriptive E mean <1 Hz and mean distinct-E fraction per 10 ms <1%; report values and events separately.

removed.threshold_lowering: all E thresholds restored to background 18 mV
removed.stochastic_input: all cells receive independent Poisson arrivals at background nu; no localized patch; global OU loading zero

retained: Neuron positions, connection partners/delays, global kernel, GABA weights and kinetics match E; D mean external drive matches the earlier silent D, not the local E patch.
pairing_boundary: Same seed and network topology. External streams intentionally differ because the local OU patch is replaced by uniform independent Poisson input; not a pure threshold intervention.
source_candidate_role: Global topology provenance only; no core masks/thresholds/weight blocks active in D0
background_selection: First condition: restore native independent Poisson shot noise globally at unchanged background mean; no output-dependent seed or window choice.
metadata_correction: Inherited D/E field text in frozen execution design described the earlier threshold-only diagnostic. Corrected here using actual zeroed core masks, uniform thresholds, restored global weights and all-stochastic external mask; no trajectory modification.
